methodologies.name: MCP Tool Failure & HTTP Response Recovery

remove_decision_rules: HTTP response contains '[object ob]' AND the same endpoint returns valid JSON on a subsequent probe within 5 seconds
HTTP response contains '[object ob]' AND the endpoint consistently returns malformed responses over 3 consecutive probes
remove_heuristics: HTTP response body contains '[object ob]' or similar unparseable object placeholder

add_decision_rules.name: rewrite R0
add_decision_rules.condition: HTTP response contains '[object ob]' AND the same endpoint returns valid JSON on a subsequent probe
add_decision_rules.outcome: Retry the original MCP tool call; if it succeeds, mark as recovered. If it fails again, escalate to permanent failure.

add_decision_rules.name: rewrite R1
add_decision_rules.condition: HTTP response contains '[object ob]' AND the endpoint returns malformed responses on every probe, with no valid answer in between
add_decision_rules.outcome: Do not retry; mark the profile start as permanently failed. Log the container id and the malformed HTTP path for manual intervention.

add_heuristics.condition: HTTP response body contains '[object ob]' or similar unparseable object placeholder
add_heuristics.action: Do not extract fields from the malformed body; record the attempt as failed with reason 'http_object_error' and let a fresh probe of the endpoint decide whether the call is retried (rules above) — never decide from the malformed body itself.

add_principles.name: Fail Fast on Object Errors
add_principles.description: When an HTTP response contains an unexpected object type (e.g., [object ob]), flag the attempt as failed and stop parsing that body; whether the call is retried is decided by a fresh probe of the endpoint.

add_decision_rules.condition: An AMT re-expansion container is [CoordinationReceived] and MCP tool 'farm_profile_start' fails with class 'profile_id missing or malformed'; the malformed profile_id has been corrected at least once but persists across attempts
add_decision_rules.outcome: Halt re-expansion for the target container; escalate to operator with corrected malformed value and full error history; do not advance to next coordination phase

add_decision_rules.name: rewrite R1
add_decision_rules.condition: MCP tool 'farm_profile_start' fails with a transient error (timeout, connection reset, provider unavailable) and the malformed profile_id has already been validated as well-formed
add_decision_rules.outcome: Retry with exponential backoff starting at 1s; when the same error comes back unchanged after a retry, classify it as a permanent failure and surface it to the operator

add_decision_rules.name: rewrite R2
add_decision_rules.condition: MCP tool 'farm_profile_start' fails permanently (retrying has stopped), or the malformed profile_id persists even after correction
add_decision_rules.outcome: Surface full error context (original payload, attempt number, error class, malformed value) to operator; keep the target container in [CoordinationReceived] until operator acknowledges resolution

add_principles.name: Retry with Backoff
add_principles.description: Transient MCP tool failures (timeouts, connection resets) are retried with exponential backoff until the error stops changing, so re-expansion does not stall indefinitely on a flaky provider.

add_principles.name: No Guessed Identifiers

add_principles.name: Validation-Before-Proceed Gate

add_decision_rules.condition: Initial build completed successfully AND keyword 're-expansion' is present
add_decision_rules.outcome: Execute re-expansion using the build artifacts as the baseline; preserve the main AMT designation throughout the expansion; abort if expansion encounters an error mid-way.

add_decision_rules.name: rewrite R4
add_decision_rules.condition: Re-expansion completed AND no error flags are set on the container
add_decision_rules.outcome: Validate that the container is in a consistent post-expansion state with the main AMT intact and sibling AMTs unaffected; report success or trigger automatic rollback to pre-expansion snapshot.

add_decision_rules.name: image pull / registry failure
add_decision_rules.condition: The failure involves container image pull or registry authentication

add_decision_rules.name: unparseable response body
add_decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start returns a response body that is '[object Object]' or otherwise unparseable
add_decision_rules.outcome: Do not extract fields from that body. Probe the endpoint again with farm_status: if it answers with valid JSON, retry farm_profile_start once farm_profiles shows the profile is not running; if every probe keeps returning unparseable bodies, mark the start permanently failed, do not retry, and record the profile id and the request path for the operator.

add_decision_rules.name: missing or malformed profile id
add_decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start fails because the profile_id is missing, empty or malformed
add_decision_rules.outcome: Do not retry with the same value and do not guess, derive or alter another id. Compare the value with the profile ids farm_profiles lists; if farm_state_get shows the coordination flags or container mapping for this container naming exactly one listed profile, use that one; otherwise halt this start and surface the offending value, the container id and the error history to the operator.

requires.name: farm_profiles

add_decision_rules.name: transient failure
add_decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start fails with a transient error (timeout, connection reset, provider unavailable)
add_decision_rules.outcome: Retry with an increasing wait, carrying the original error and the attempt number forward; when the same error comes back unchanged after a retry and the farm shows no change, treat it as a permanent failure and surface it to the operator.

requires.name: farm_status

add_decision_rules.name: permanent failure
add_decision_rules.condition: A farm_profile_start failure is permanent
add_decision_rules.outcome: Surface the full error context (original payload, attempt number, error class, offending value) to the operator and keep the container in its current coordination state until the operator acknowledges; do not advance to the next coordination phase.

add_decision_rules.name: one profile fails
add_decision_rules.condition: farm_profile_start fails for one profile while farm_profiles shows the other profiles unaffected
add_decision_rules.outcome: Continue with the other profiles and set the failed one aside for recovery; resolve each profile independently so a failure in one does not block or cascade into the rest.

add_decision_rules.outcome: Resolve the container id first with farm_state_get (container mappings) before retrying the profile start.
